steps.title: Bem-vindo: Sports - Volume 1
steps.text: In this A1-level lesson, we'll explore essential vocabulary and phrases about "Sports". Get ready to level up your real-world communication skills!

words.example: I've been a fan of this team since I was a kid.
What's the score of the game?
The stadium was packed for the final.

steps.text: It means: "To face a difficult situation with courage.". Say the example sentence out loud:
steps.targetPhrase: I hate going to the dentist, but I'll just have to bite the bullet.
